unsupported_claims: The downstream benefit details (BlogCatalog, Flickr, YouTube, as few as about 1% labeled) are not contained in the provided evidence excerpts, though they may come from the broader paper.
rationale: The core claim that DeepWalk representations capture shared local neighborhood similarity (encoding cocitation similarity) and aid generalization on ML tasks is directly supported by the evidence. However, the specific datasets and the 1% labeled figure, as well as the online-update claim framed as a benefit, go beyond the provided excerpts, so they cannot be verified from the evidence shown.
